TITLE: The same color, but it looks different?
NEXT: NEXT: Say the color of the words!

EN.A 칸과 B 칸,\n어느 쪽이 더 진할까요?:
Square A or square B —
which one is darker?
EN.같은 색 막대로 이어 볼게요: Let's connect them with a bar of one color
EN.어? 막대랑 두 칸이\n이어져 보여요!:
Huh? The bar and both squares
blend together!
EN.둘레를 지워 보면: Now let's erase everything around them
EN.A 와 B 는 똑같은 색!: A and B are exactly the same color!
EN.뇌는 그림자가 있으면\n\"원래는 더 밝다\"고 계산해요:
When there's a shadow, your brain figures
"it must really be lighter"
EN.그래서 그림자 속 B 를\n밝은 칸이라고 고쳐 봐요:
So it corrects B in the shadow
and sees it as a light square
EN.눈에 들어온 빛 그대로가 아니라\n뇌가 계산한 색을 보는 거예요:
You don't see the light exactly as it enters your eye —
you see the color your brain works out
EN.그늘 속 흰 종이를\n회색이라고 안 하는 것도 이 덕분!:
That's also why white paper in the shade
doesn't look gray to you!
EN.눈의 비밀 2부, 끝!: That's the end of Secrets of the Eye, Part 2!
